_note: Reviewed, fixed wording shown to users. These are never generated by the AI. Any change needs team review, because people in distress read these messages.
crisis: I'm really sorry you're going through this, and I'm glad you said something. I'm an AI, so I can't help with this safely here, but you deserve support from a person right now. Please call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or call 911 if you are in immediate danger. If you can, let someone you trust know how you're feeling.
harmful_instructions: I can't help with that. If you're thinking about hurting yourself, please call or text 988 now to talk with someone at the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or call 911 if you are in immediate danger. You don't have to go through this alone.
immediate_danger: Your safety matters most right now. If you are in immediate danger, please call 911 or go to a safe place if you can. I'm an AI and can't help in an emergency, but the people at 911 and 988 can.
harm_to_others: It sounds like things feel very intense right now. I can't help with anything that could hurt someone. If you feel you might act on these thoughts, please call 911, or call or text 988 to talk with someone right away.
abuse_disclosure: Thank you for telling me. What you're describing is not your fault, and you deserve to be safe. I'm an AI and can't assess your situation, but the people at the resources below are trained to help and will listen. If you are in danger right now, please call 911.
severe_distress: It sounds like you're carrying a lot right now, and I'm glad you reached out. I'm an AI and can't give you the support a person can, but you can call or text 988 at any time to talk with someone, even if it isn't an emergency. Is there someone you trust you could reach out to today?
isolation: Feeling this alone is really hard, and it makes sense that it weighs on you. I'm an AI, so I can't replace the people in your life, but you don't have to carry this by yourself. You can call or text 988 any time to talk with someone, and reaching out to even one person you trust can help.
dependency: I'm glad these conversations feel helpful. I'm an AI, though, and I can't take the place of the people in your life. The support of someone you trust really matters. Is there one person you could reach out to this week?
concern_for_other: It sounds like you're worried about someone, and it's caring of you to take it seriously. If they might be in danger, call 911. You can also call or text 988 to get advice on how to support them, and encourage them to reach out too.
output_blocked: I'd like to step back from how I started to answer that. I'm an AI wellness companion, so I can't diagnose, give medical advice, or take the place of the people and professionals in your life. Would you like to tell me a little more about how you're feeling right now?
